editorial:
Imagine a world where the hospital is just as dangerous as the streets. You get to follow Dr. Sloan, a guy who is great at medicine but even better at solving crimes. Things get personal when his old flame, the famous heart surgeon Dr. Rachel Walters, comes to town for a big surgery on a US Senator. The vibe is a classic 90s mystery where everyone looks professional on the outside, but someone is hiding a dark secret. You will feel the tension as Sloan realizes that this isn't just a medical accident, but a cold-blooded murder happening right under everyone's noses.

What really works here is the chemistry between the doctors and the slow reveal of the motive. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel a bit like an old TV episode. The acting is solid, and the mystery keeps you guessing about how the crime was actually done. If you enjoy a good whodunnit with a medical twist, you should definitely check this out. Since it is an older title, you might want to look for a restored version to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a great move if you love collecting rare gems.
endingExplained: The big reveal shows that Dr. Walters killed Senator Cabot to get revenge for her daughter, who was left in a coma by the Senator's hit-and-run years ago. She used a clever trick to infect him with deadly bacteria during the surgery while cameras were rolling. She managed to hide the contamination so it looked like a natural failure. Eventually, Dr. Sloan figures out the method, leading to her arrest and a sad end to her revenge plan.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves medical mysteries and classic detective stories.
